question: What does the angry one destroy in the triple world?
premises: kruddhaḥ tu saṃharet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sa cara acaram
the triple world includes moving and unmoving
inference: When angry, he destroys all in the triple world, moving and unmoving.
uncertainties: whether sa cara acaram is a compound
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all in the triple world, moving and unmoving.
